scripts.package:linux: npm run build:linux:binary && npm run bundle:linux && npm run sign:updates:linux
scripts.bundle:linux: node scripts/prepare-linux-packaging-tools.mjs && npm run prepare:linux && npm run bundle:linux:portable && npm run bundle:linux:rpm
scripts.bundle:linux:portable: node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs tauri bundle --bundles deb && node scripts/finalize-linux-deb.mjs && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs tauri bundle --bundles appimage && node scripts/finalize-linux-appimage.mjs
scripts.bundle:linux:rpm: node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs tauri bundle --bundles rpm && node scripts/build-linux-rpm.mjs
scripts.bench:remote:session: node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p noosphere-remote --bin noosphere-remote-bench --release -- --session
scripts.bench:remote: node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p noosphere-remote --bin noosphere-remote-bench --release --
scripts.test:remote:e2e: node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p noosphere-remote --bin noosphere-remote-lab --release -- --output remote-test-results/two-node-lab
scripts.smoke:remote:live: node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p noosphere-remote --bin noosphere-remote-lab --release -- --gpu --output remote-test-results/two-node-live-gpu
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:rust
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace
scripts.lint: oxlint app components src lib scripts tests && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: oxfmt && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p noosphere-desktop -p noosphere-remote
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check && node scripts/native-toolchain.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p noosphere-desktop -p noosphere-remote -- --check
